summary: Hall of Heroes troops return at the end of the Season of Conquest even if the governor is offline; separate siege healing zone outside hospital capacity (added in wave J).
SoC story Siege of Orléans (auxiliary commanders). Legendary engineering and gathering equipment. Armament transmute.
Greece civilization. SoC story Storm of Stratagems (S–D team classes). Armament transmutation (max 10).
Iconic equipment awakening (5 tiers, Season 1+). City theme transmog. Hall of Fame. King of the Nile seasonal strategies capped per season (C04-0620, wave J).
Preparation Season starting provinces cut from 6 to 3. Talents and inscriptions can trigger on ranged attacks.
SoC events removed: Now or Never, Barbarian Buster, Lord of War, Territory Grab, Strategic Reserves. Museum relics work in SoC only.
SoC story Shifting Gears (shifter/skirmisher/artillery troops). Cross-season immigration: 20,000-Gem deposit, minimum 10M power, power cap 85M. Recruitment Plaza.
Delta formation (+10% combo). Armament wishlist. CH25 required for SoC registration.
VIP19 and SVIP (excess VIP points refunded). SoC key story King of All Britain. Vacation Permit.
Realm of Mystique (PvE). Hall of Heroes refunds part of healing resources. Targeted immigration changed.
Maya civilization. King Arthur. Armament Conversion. Legendary Commander Swap. Gathering of Heroes. Immediate re-registration for SoC. Lv25 Trading Post capacity 5M→10M.
Wheel of Fortune needs Spin Tickets (Season 3/SoC); SoC pool trades construction speedups for healing. Midseason Review replaces Enemy Elimination. Remastered map on by default.

Lost Kingdom tier system (gems; Hall of Heroes return rate). Crystal tech rework begins as a pioneer. Takeda, Cyrus, Cheok and Bertrand moved to Season 2 and reworked. Spin Tickets in Season 2. Transmutation guarantee. Past Glory stage 1 buff cut from 40% to 30%.

SoC team-up phase and match voting. Kingdom power formula (tiered cap; nothing counted above 500M). Imperium threshold 23.5B. Alliance Fortress durability cut. Eve of the Crusade moves inside the Lost Kingdom.

Supreme Strife tournament. Out-of-combat troops gain no Rage. Archimedes and Mary I added. Special-talent equipment dismantle refunds 100% of forging. Queens, Generals and Prime Ministers can use king skills. Officer permission categories.
SoC key story Song of Troy (Achilles, Hector). Oasis Bazaar event (sell resources for Gems). Watchlist king skill. Domains opened one at a time. Karuak troops capped at level 30.
Acclaim fully live. Army Groups (pioneer). Domains need 600 active governors. Queue panel at CH8. Alliance markers. Civilization buff switching at CH16. Morale removed from Champions of Olympia.

Daily AP claim can exceed cap. Army Groups for all SoC alliances. Swap/Gathering of Heroes tuned (Season 3 Light and Darkness). RoK Toolkit roster import. First-purchase gem multiplier returns (2026-01-01).

Armament honing. Lost Kingdom tier A+. Kingdom Merger 3→2 kingdoms. Coalitions start with 4 alliances. Forced by-election. Home-kingdom territory protection in SoC. Battle-report skill statistics. Supreme Strife becomes 1v1. Alliance Bounty/Armory (pioneer).

Talent/inscription rework: skill-damage reduction now covers combo and smite (Season 2+). Song of Troy patrons rebalanced. Acclaim from T1 units nerfed. Acclaim Shop (Recovery Potions). Weekly cap on Alliance Bounty resources. 4 new queues.

Wedge Formation II (+12% skill). Gem events to reset equipment talents or refund a dismantle. Immigration age limits tightened. Same-season immigration locked until end of Season 1 (pioneer). Oasis Bazaar permanent in SoC (Trading Post Lv25). Bastion quests no longer require speedups.
Conduct Score (scripts/cheats penalised; SoC first). King of All Britain pioneer as Season 3. Alliance Notes, Quick Checks. Auto-peacekeeping improvements.
Clash of Divine Isles reworked (cross-kingdom invasion event). Rest Mode vote. Secondary password needed to inscribe or convert armaments. World Cup events.
Resource boosts and Deceptive Troops items removed; VIP production bonuses raised. Daily quests changed. Legendary Pelagius from day 5. Duel of Heroes (Heroic Anthem). Bulk gathering items.
Radiant Rivalry (pioneer, new kingdoms). Yahya ibn Khalid (Legendary gatherer, Season 1+). SoC story Mighty Assembly (pioneer). Pincer +12% smite. Good Conduct Reward.

Radiant Rivalry wider. Camp Treaty (pioneer). Chronicles key chapters fixed to Fri–Sat. Season 2/3 level-4 passes semi-protected. Acclaim in Seasons 1–3. Eve of the Crusade opens with the Lost Kingdom. Past Glory stage 2 uses speedups. Season 1 Wheel of Fortune needs Spin Tickets.
